item.title: Netflix set to buy Warner Bros. in deal valued at $83 billion
item.description: Netflix has announced that it has entered a "definitive agreement" to acquire Warner Bros. in a deal valued at approximately $83 billion.

item.title: Michael Jordan and Joe Gibbs' daughter-in-law testify Friday in NASCAR antitrust case
item.description: Michael Jordan testified on Friday in the landmark NASCAR antitrust trial in Charlotte.

item.title: How Netflix acquiring Warner Bros. could change the future of movies
item.description: Netflix acquiring Warner Bros. is a deal that would put a lot of power in the hands of one company. Critics fear the combo would be bad news for moviegoers and for people who work in theaters.

item.title: Federal judge appears skeptical of Trump's ongoing command of California National Guard troops
item.description: At a hearing in San Francisco, U.S. District Judge Charles Breyer suggested conditions in Los Angeles had changed since the initial deployment, and he questioned whether the administration could control state Guard troops "forever" under its interpretation of federal law.

item.title: Frank Gehry, legendary architect who designed LA's Walt Disney Concert Hall, dies at 96
item.description: Frank Gehry died in his Santa Monica home at 96. The world-renowned architect helped shape the way Los Angeles looks today.

item.title: Pig butchering: Bay Area widow loses nearly $1M in crypto scheme, ChatGPT alerts her to scam
item.description: "ChatGPT told me no, this is a scam, you better go to police station... so I panicked at that time, I panicked and I call him. I say, you are scamming me!" the victim said.

item.title: Bay Area soccer fans excitedly cheer on 2026 FIFA World Cup draw
item.description: From PayPal Park to Thrive City, fans from all over the Bay Area cheered on and celebrated as the 2026 FIFA World Cup draw selected which groups would be coming to Levi's Stadium.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Foggy in some areas, chilly overnight into morning
item.description: Expect another round of fog for parts of the Bay Area overnight. It may be dense in patches by morning. The sun will break through by the afternoon.

item.title: 2026 World Cup matches: Who's playing at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara?
item.description: Could there be a Messi appearance at Levi's Stadium next year for the FIFA World Cup? Here's what we know about who's playing in Santa Clara.

item.title: Man who attended Stockton birthday party arrested amid mass shooting investigation, DA says
item.description: A California man who attended the birthday party that was at the center of a mass shooting that killed four people, including three kids, has been arrested for a parole violation.
